passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Kalanchoe × estrelae Gideon F.Sm..
The native range of this hybrid is Northern Prov. It is a succulent subshrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome. The hybrid formula is K. luciae × K. sexangularis.
